steps.caption: Open Leases, then the Portfolio tab.
Aggregates use only known, compatible values. Missing data is listed, never treated as zero.
The tiles: active leases, leased area, monthly and annual rent, expiries, renewal deadlines, escalations, lock-ins, terminations and obligations.
Under each total: how many leases were included and how many excluded.
By status: how many leases are draft, active, expiring and so on.
Excluded from totals, and leases with incomplete information: each one says what is missing — for example rent or a confirmed expiry.
Filter by category, micro-market or your own leases.
The totals now cover Kharadi leases only.
